easy.description: Direct concept recall and standard formula application with clear numerical values.
easy.calculation_complexity: Low; direct arithmetic or basic algebraic substitution.
easy.concept_complexity: Single foundational concept without tricky constraints.
easy.required_interpretation: Minimal text processing; straightforward question structure.
easy.distractor_difficulty: Distinct distractors based on basic arithmetic errors or sign flips.

medium.description: Multi-step reasoning combining 2 to 3 related concepts or requiring moderate algebraic modeling.
medium.calculation_complexity: Moderate; fractions, decimals, or simultaneous linear relationships.
medium.concept_complexity: Integration of two core subtopics (e.g., percentage change linked with profit/loss).
medium.required_interpretation: Moderate word problem requiring identification of invariants or target unknowns.
medium.distractor_difficulty: Plausible distractors reflecting intermediate calculation steps or inverted ratios.

hard.description: Advanced problem solving requiring non-obvious variable elimination, geometric visualization, or constrained case-checking.
hard.reasoning_steps: 3 - 5 steps with branching logic or algebraic transformations
hard.calculation_complexity: High; multi-stage arithmetic, quadratic roots, or fractional ratios.
hard.concept_complexity: Deep conceptual synthesis across subtopics or edge-case constraints.
hard.required_interpretation: Subtle phrasing, conditional dependencies, or secondary question clauses.
hard.distractor_difficulty: Trap-heavy distractors reflecting standard cognitive biases and incomplete conditions.

very_hard.description: Elite Olympiad/CAT 99th-percentile calibre problems requiring modular shortcuts, geometric invariants, or multi-case Diophantine deduction.
very_hard.reasoning_steps: 5+ steps or elegant non-standard mathematical insight
very_hard.calculation_complexity: Intense manual calculation or sophisticated algebraic factoring/modulo analysis.
very_hard.concept_complexity: Exhaustive boundary testing, extreme-case analysis, or abstract properties.
very_hard.required_interpretation: High cognitive load; problem statement embeds subtle mathematical traps.
very_hard.distractor_difficulty: Sophisticated distractors targeting near-miss mathematical derivations.
